// Get final stats let stats = flow.get('processStats') || {}; // Only generate summary if process is complete or was already complete if (!stats.status.includes('Completed')) { return null; } // Calculate duration const startTime = new Date(stats.startTime); const endTime = new Date(stats.endTime); const duration = (endTime - startTime) / 1000; // in seconds // Create HTML email content const htmlContent = `

MikroTik Address List Synchronization Summary

Process completed at: ${endTime.toLocaleString()}

Processing Statistics:

Metric Count
Total Suspended IPs ${stats.suspendedIPs}
Current Blocked IPs ${stats.currentBlockedIPs}
IPs Added ${stats.completedAdds}
IPs Removed ${stats.completedRemoves}

Process Details:

  • Start Time: ${new Date(stats.startTime).toLocaleString()}
  • End Time: ${new Date(stats.endTime).toLocaleString()}
  • Duration: ${duration.toFixed(2)} seconds
  • Final Status: ${stats.status}

Note: This is an automated message from the MikroTik Sync Process.

`; // Create email message with just the content msg.payload = htmlContent; return msg;
